identification: Oil of fishing boats moored in haze, signed lower right. Signature on the photo is a small scrawl, not clearly legible as Brian Baigent; catalogue attribution unverified. Brian Charles Baigent (1929-2000) is a Sydney painter (Ku-ring-gai, harbour, Cowan Waters), not Victorian as the scan note claims; Lakes Entrance title may still fit if he travelled. Gilt frame with linen slip, roughly 50x60cm image.
